segments.name: Battery cells and packs sales segment
segments.description: Sells battery cells and battery packs, managed separately because each business needs different technology and marketing.
segments.evidence: For battery packs, we leverage existing trade relationships, channel partners and repeat customers.

segments.name: Electronic control system sales segment
products: intelligent robots and related smart hardware
segments.description: Sells electronic control systems and intelligent robots directly to OEM, industrial and municipal customers.
segments.evidence: For electronic control systems, we pursue direct sales to OEM and industrial customers, supported by solution demonstrations, technical consulting and design-in support.

segments.name: Others segment
segments.description: Sells second-hand machinery and provides maintenance services and photovoltaic engineering contracting.
segments.evidence: The Group determined it has three operating segments: (1) sales of battery cells and packs, (2) sales of electronic control system and intelligent robot and (3) others, which mainly included the sales of second-hand machinery, the provision of maintenance services and photovoltaic engineering contracting.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for battery cells and packs, electronic control systems, intelligent robots, second-hand machinery, maintenance services and photovoltaic engineering.
revenueModel.evidence: Our sales and marketing is primarily customer- and project-driven.
